name: Taokaenoi Food & Marketing Public Company Limited
summary: Taokaenoi Food & Marketing Public Company Limited manufactures and distributes fried, grilled, and baked seaweed and seaweed snacks in Thailand and internationally. It operates through Snacks, Retailer, and Others segments. The company operates as a retailer of snacks, and food and beverage products. It is also involved in the distribution of snacks and souvenirs; manufacture and distribution of seasoning powders; restaurant business; as well as manufacturing, procurement, and distribution of ready-to-eat packaged popcorn. In addition, the company imports, trades, and distributes its products. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Pak Kret, Thailand.
